question: Boxing Federation of India (BFI) hosted the 2021 men's national championships in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National boxing championships for elite men return this year after getting hit by the Covid-19 pandemic last year.
 
• The event was held at the Inspire Institute of Sports in Vijayanagara, Karnataka, from September 15 to 21.
 
• Shiva Thapa successfully defended his title at the men’s national boxing championships 2021.
 
• While Mohammad Hussamuddin had to settle for silver.
